scope: Shared physical circulation derivatives, exact node/element maps, constant input derivatives in mixed sweeps, single-evaluation output snapshots.

drela_comparison.output_method: One physical evaluation at each original real/imaginary positive/negative perturbation; full C/Q/D output matrices are not preassembled.
drela_comparison.setup_differences: Fixed aircraft frame; all declared controls plus a gust; 0.1-100rad/T. Published rudder plot includes aircraft motion over0.1-10cycles/s. Exact trim, constraints and discretization unknown.
drela_comparison.structural_discretization: Objective SO(3) midpoint rather than the documented Euler-angle averaging.

limitations: Full ASWING goal and independent ASWING parity remain incomplete.
The complete Newton Jacobian is not yet shared with the dynamic solver; geometry derivatives still use full residual stencils.
Controllers and unavailable direct circulation branches retain numerical circulation derivatives. Initial spectra retain dense finite-subspace reduction.
Fixed-frame DAE timings do not reproduce the published ASWING flight-response configuration.
Shared-host timings and mixed-unit output-group ratios are observations, not portable latency guarantees or universal physical error bounds.
